notable_claims: The Board of Regents mandated warnings for sexually-graphic material in classrooms.
Faculty members claimed the policy infringes on academic freedom.
classification.summary: The state Board of Regents established a policy requiring faculty at the University of Iowa, Iowa State University, and the University of Northern Iowa to warn students before presenting sexually explicit materials. Some faculty members argued that this requirement constitutes an infringement on academic freedom.
classification.title: Regents approve sex policy
